hooks.name: Document Feature Changes
hooks.description: Reminds to update documentation (changelog, API docs, diagrams) after completing a spec task

action.prompt:
After completing this task, ensure documentation is updated according to the project's documentation standards:
1. Update docs/CHANGELOG.md with the change (Added/Changed/Fixed format, include Jira issue ID if applicable)
2. If new API endpoints were added or modified, verify Swagger/OpenAPI docs are accurate
3. If the change affects system architecture (new services, integrations, data models), update the relevant diagram in docs/architecture/
4. If setup instructions changed, update README.md

Documentation is part of "Done" — the task is not complete without it.
